lanes.summary: The diff successfully implements the `raw-samples-v1` emitter and contract as requested in PMAT-4551. It captures per-iteration samples (wall time, completion tokens, TTFT) without computing any derived statistics, refusing to invent data for unsupported paths. The contract and falsification tests are fully implemented according to the acceptance criteria. It also includes a necessary fix to the ontology shapes parser to support multiple nested nodes within a single contract, which was required for the `raw-samples-v1` shape definition.

findings.claim: `apr bench --emit raw-samples-v1` writes raw per-iteration samples plus the identity the subject can know, and no derived statistics.

`contracts/apr-raw-samples-v1.yaml` validates a real committed emit and refuses negative cases like a derived key, null identity field, short digest, empty sample list, undeclared backend, and foreign schema (FALSIFY-RAWS-001).
The emitter refuses a bench path without per-iteration samples, or samples that do not match the timed iterations (FALSIFY-RAWS-002).
To support multiple nested `node` definitions in `apr-raw-samples-v1.yaml`, the ontology parser assigns distinct nested shape IDs.

lanes.summary: Diff implements PMAT-4551 correctly. Contract validates real emit and rejects all planted defects (AC-1): closed shape prevents unknown keys; minCount: 1 rejects null identity fields; pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ rejects short digests; minCount: 1 rejects empty samples; backend enum rejects undeclared values; schema enum rejects foreign versions. Emitter refuses unrecorded samples (AC-2): returns Err when result.raw.is_none() or sample count ≠ iteration count. Qwen35 path populates per-iteration RawSample {wall, completion_tokens, ttft}. Compute_class() in scope. Out-of-scope items (ledger row, recorder, backfill) correctly omitted. Bonus: nested node shape IRI collision fixed.
